title: Data Labeling Tool
tagline: Image and text-based document annotation tool
summary: An enterprise annotation platform for text, PDFs and images (NLP and Visual NER). I started on the backend (Flask/Django APIs, PostgreSQL, Keycloak IAM) and later took on the frontend as well, including the move to React. Top contributor out of 75 developers.
overview: An enterprise data labeling platform. Teams use it to annotate text, PDFs and images for NLP and Visual NER, manage annotators and reviewers, and train or pre-annotate with pretrained NLP models.

I was assigned to the project during my internship and started on the backend: Flask and Django REST APIs, SQLAlchemy models and migrations, PostgreSQL design for labeling workflows, audit logs and reporting, and Keycloak authentication and RBAC. I then took on the frontend as well, leading the migration from server-rendered templates to a React/Redux app and building Visual NER annotation. By the end I was the top committer out of 75 contributors, working across backend, frontend, security, testing and deployment.

points: Built Flask and Django REST APIs for image and text annotation workflows, user actions and platform operations.
Wrote controllers, helpers and Swagger API documentation for the platform’s services.
Designed and worked extensively with PostgreSQL for application data, labeling workflows, audit logs and reporting.
Built SQLAlchemy models and managed schema changes through Alembic migrations.
Integrated Keycloak IAM for secure authentication and Role-Based Access Control.
Moved UMA policies from role-based to client-based, configured protocol mappers, and fixed token refresh and session-expiry handling.
Task assignment (annotators see only their own tasks), reviewer flows, per-user task status and "serve next task after review".
Sharing projects with multiple users at once, permission view/revoke, and task filters for annotators and reviewers.
Chunked upload for large project imports, export filters, and CoNLL / tag-based export.
Built the Models Hub from scratch: browse, download, upload, retry and delete pretrained models, with language filters, pagination, download limits and a model evaluation UI.
Wrote Pytest API tests and Selenium UI suites run in CI on every pull request.
Containerized services with Docker and deployed them to AWS EC2; worked with Airflow-based workflows.
Led the move from server-rendered Jinja templates to a React/Redux app: Projects, Create Project, Setup, Models Hub, Settings, Profile and the core Labeling page.
Built reusable modals, toasts and confirm boxes, documented them in Storybook, and upgraded the embedded open-source labeling engine.
Visual NER for PDFs (2022): cross-page annotation, chunk search, "label all occurrences", pagination, relations on regions and confidence-score display.
Drafts and auto-save with history, hide/unhide regions, inter-annotator agreement charts, and filters that persist across navigation (React, Redux, MobX).

achievements: Top committer out of 75 contributors (1,871 commits).
Built the backend foundation: APIs, PostgreSQL data model and Keycloak RBAC.
Led the React/Redux migration of the whole application UI.
Grew from backend developer to full-stack owner over 3+ years.
